# Response to the question

The pentagon has 5 sides, so it can be divided into 5 − 2 = 3 triangles by drawing diagonals from one vertex. The lines from A to D and from A to C split the pentagon into triangles AED, ADC, and ABC. Each triangle has interior angles summing to 180°, so the sum of the interior angles of the pentagon is 3 × 180° = 540°. Check using the formula (n − 2) × 180° with n = 5: (5 − 2) × 180° = 3 × 180° = 540°. Answer: 540°
